title: MINOR: Clarify Quickstart Connect command arguments
body:
The current explanation of the configuration files used in the
_standalone_ Connect example may give the impression that the command
accepts exactly three configuration parameters. It also explains the
purpose of the files without first making the argument structure clear.
For readers who are new to Kafka, clarifying the command structure first
can make the roles of the configuration files easier to understand.

This change clarifies that the example uses one worker configuration
followed by two connector configurations, while preserving the existing
explanation of what each configuration contains.

Reviewers: Andrew Schofield <aschofield@confluent.io>
